policies.topic: Semester Fee Deadlines and Installment Schedules
policies.summary: Semester tuition fees must be paid within 15 calendar days of the semester start date. Late fine of ₹100/day applies thereafter.
policies.details: Tuition fees can be paid via net banking, UPI, or credit/debit card through the official payment portal. Installment facility (2 equal parts) is available upon formal request approved by the Finance Officer prior to the semester start.
policies.actionable: Pay via Finance Portal or submit an installment hardship request to Finance & Accounts.

policies.topic: Payment Gateway Discrepancies and Unpaid Portal Status
policies.summary: Payments debited from student bank accounts usually sync within 2 to 4 hours. If portal shows unpaid after debit, an official ticket must be created.
policies.details: Due to bank settlement cycles, successful debits may occasionally experience webhook timeout. Students MUST NOT pay twice. Note your Bank UTR / Transaction Reference Number, bank debit SMS timestamp, and account number. The Finance department will manually reconcile the transaction within 24 business hours.
keywords: payment completed but portal shows pending
policies.actionable: Do not pay again. Provide Bank UTR number and transaction receipt in an official ticket to Finance & Accounts for instant reconciliation.

policies.topic: Fee Refund and Security Deposit Clearance
policies.summary: Caution deposit refunds are processed after final semester graduation upon clearance of all departmental no-dues.
policies.details: Refunds are credited directly to the registered student bank account within 30 days of submitting the consolidated No-Dues Certificate.
policies.actionable: Submit bank passbook copy and No-Dues clearance to Finance Counter #3 or raise a ticket.
